privacy.text: Privacy policy

Updated 20 October 2026. This policy covers the KiwiKind Broadband Android app and customer portal. KiwiKind Broadband Limited (NZBN 9429054036550), incorporated on 19 October 2026, operates this prelaunch project. Free accounts and support conversations are available. Broadband orders, supplier processing and payments remain closed; incorporation does not establish an operating ISP. The Google Play developer display name is FryMasterCheese Studios.
Contact
For support, privacy, access, correction or account deletion, email kiwikindbroadband@gmail.com. You do not need to sign in to contact us.
Information we collect

Signing in sends your email and account identifiers to our backend. Google sign-in supplies a verified email and Google account identifier; we do not receive your Google password. Email/password sign-in sends your password over HTTPS; the backend stores a one-way password hash, not a readable password. Essential cookies maintain sessions and protect forms. Android stores its session encrypted with a key held by Android Keystore; a session is still checked by the server.

If you choose to send support or privacy messages, we collect their subject, category, contents and timestamps. Do not include payment-card details, identity documents or health information. Security and service logs can contain request paths, timestamps, network addresses, browser/device information and authentication/audit events.

Broadband orders, payments and provisioning are disabled. No active service, price or coverage is promised. Address, contact name, postcode and optional phone fields exist in the software for future requests, but customer intake is closed. We will update relevant notices before enabling collection for live services.
How information is used

We use account data to authenticate you, maintain your account, show your own records across the website and Android app, respond to your messages, provide privacy controls and prevent abuse. A website session and Android session are separate; they access the same server-side account. Account and support records are not passed to advertising placements. Advertising SDK behavior in the V8 test build is described below; V6 and V7 are ad-free.
Hosting and service providers

The portal is hosted on Render, with PostgreSQL data hosted by Neon. Current service regions are Singapore for the application and Sydney, Australia for the database. GitHub Pages hosts the separate public information website; account sign-in remains on the Render portal. Google processes Google sign-in. When configured, Brevo processes transactional verification/reset email, including recipient address and the message needed for account recovery. Email delivery can be unavailable during prelaunch. These providers process information to deliver the specified functions; we do not sell personal information or provide account/support records for targeted advertising. Google advertising SDK processing is described below. Provider operational processing may occur overseas.
Referral preview and account preferences

If you choose to create a referral code, we store the code against your account. When referral registration is enabled, we record who referred a new account and whether its email is verified. Referral history shows status and date, not invited people’s email addresses. Codes are shareable; share them only where appropriate. Rewards, discounts, financial credits and referral registration are disabled during prelaunch. Notification preferences are stored with your account, but notification delivery and marketing remain disabled.
Advertising preparation

The approved public information website does not load advertising code. Android V6 and V7 are ad-free. The V8 test-ad build includes Google Mobile Ads SDK 25.5.0 and User Messaging Platform 4.0.0 in release-capable code, using KiwiKind’s own AdMob App ID and banner unit. Requests are limited to SDK-recognised test devices; other phones keep banners off. No live advertising is authorised. A banner is shown only on public Home, after Google’s consent checks permit a request. Sign-in, account, support, billing, privacy and deletion screens have no advertising placements.
Advertising data and choices

The Google SDKs may process IP address and general location, app interactions, diagnostic information and device or installation identifiers for test-ad delivery, measurement and fraud prevention. Data may be transmitted to Google and its advertising technology providers, including processing overseas. Removing the Android Advertising ID permission does not eliminate all SDK data processing; the V8 build removes that permission and does not request precise device location. No KiwiKind email address, password, support message, billing record or referral record is included in an ad request.

Google’s applicable consent message explains purposes and providers and offers Consent, Do not consent and Manage options. Refusing personalisation is distinct from preventing every permitted limited-ad request; this build still restricts every request to test devices. Use Advertising privacy choices on public Home or the native Privacy policy screen to revisit choices where Google requires an options form. Opening privacy choices removes the banner, and no automatic ad reload follows. If choices cannot load, ads remain off and essential account functions remain available.

Google controls retention of its SDK data under Google’s Privacy Policy and advertising technology information. Consent preferences may be stored on the device. KiwiKind has no advertising-cookie script on the website; existing essential account cookies remain separate. Any future live advertising, website cookies or additional providers require reviewed disclosures, applicable consent, Google approval and explicit owner authorisation before activation.
Optional private payment testing

Live payments remain disabled. Only accounts explicitly selected by the owner for testing can start a sandbox checkout. After explicit consent, the backend sends the account email, an internal test reference and the agreed test amounts to Stripe. Stripe hosts the test payment form; use only test payment details, never a real card. KiwiKind stores test agreement, invoice, payment-status, refund and dispute references so the website and app can show the same results. These records do not activate broadband and are separate from ordinary invoices. Account exports include your test records. Deletion reviews include these records and any corresponding Stripe test data; deletion is not automatic. Test status changes come from verified provider notifications, not from a browser return page. Contact us for access, correction or deletion.
Security

The connected app uses HTTPS and disallows cleartext HTTP. Access to account records is restricted by server authentication. Android app backups are disabled. No system is risk-free; protect your device and credentials, and keep account exports private. Support requests must not contain secrets.
Retention and deletion

We keep account and support records while needed for the account, support, security and any applicable legal duties. There is currently no automatic account-expiry or data-purge schedule; deletion requests are reviewed and processed manually. A request acknowledgement does not mean records have already been deleted.

On a verified deletion request, we review the account and associated support/request records for deletion. If any information must be retained for a legal or security reason, we explain the categories, reason and applicable retention period. Existing recovery snapshots may contain older copies until the snapshot is retired; they are used for recovery rather than ordinary account access. A restore must preserve verified deletion instructions.

You can request account deletion from the app or this public deletion page. Google-only users do not need a KiwiKind password to use the email pathway. We may verify control of the account email before acting, without asking for your password.
Your choices

You can sign out, request an account export in the portal/app, or contact us for access, correction and deletion. Sending support messages is optional. The app is intended for adults managing their own accounts, not children. Policy changes will be published here with a revised date.

deletion.text: This page covers the KiwiKind Broadband Android app (package nz.kiwikind.broadband) and shared website account.

Email kiwikindbroadband@gmail.com with the subject KiwiKind account deletion request. Send from the email used for your KiwiKind account if possible, and say that you want the account and its associated data deleted. You can use this page without signing in or reinstalling the app.

Google-only account? You do not need a KiwiKind password. Do not send your Google password, KiwiKind password, login code, reset link, identity document or payment information. If you cannot access the account email, explain that in your message so we can discuss proportionate verification.

We verify account ownership, review the account and associated support/request records, and process the request manually. No account or data is deleted merely by opening this page. If information must be retained for a legal or security reason, we explain what is retained, why and for how long. Recovery snapshots can contain earlier copies until retired; verified deletion instructions must be respected after recovery.

You can also request deletion from the signed-in app or portal. Google-only users can explicitly confirm a manual deletion review using their authenticated account, without setting a password. The password-protected request remains available for email/password accounts; the public email pathway is available to all users, including Google sign-in users.

Broadband orders, payments and provisioning are disabled. This deletion request does not require buying a service or paying a fee. Read our privacy policy or contact the same email for access/correction requests.

terms.text: A request is just a request.

KiwiKind Broadband is a working brand for a planned New Zealand broadband retail business. It is not yet offering a live broadband service. The legal supplier and contact details must be confirmed before customer intake opens.

Creating an account or submitting a request does not form a broadband service contract, guarantee availability, start provisioning, authorise switching or create any charge. Don’t cancel your current broadband on the basis of a request. You may cancel a pending request in the portal.

Only submit accurate details for an address you are authorised to enquire about. Protect your password. Support tickets and complaints are recorded in your account; no pre-launch response time is promised. We do not claim Telecommunications Dispute Resolution membership. A live complaints and escalation process must be approved before service launch.

Any future offer needs separate acceptance of confirmed pricing, GST, speeds and limitations, installation, equipment, minimum term, cancellation and switching terms. Nothing here excludes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded under New Zealand law, including applicable Consumer Guarantees Act and Fair Trading Act protections. These draft portal terms require review before public customer use.
